notes: The official 2022 housing questionnaire asks construction year, wall material, use, ownership, rooms, floor area, utilities, heating, fuel and equipment, but no building-type question. Schema absence cannot provide a stock distribution or WBL join.

The official static-table inventory lists housing count, ownership, basic characteristics, equipment, heating mode and comfort tables; no building-type housing table is listed. Publication absence is not a stock estimate.

KSH states that 2023-2024 transaction building-type classification also used 2022 Census results. The database covers selected sold used dwellings with calculable square-metre price, not the occupied dwelling stock, so it cannot validate the WBL stock proxy or create a WBL joint authority.
